studies.Title: Impact of heavy metals, oxidative stress, expression of VHL, and antioxidant genes in the pathogenesis of renal cell carcinoma.
studies.Reference: Impact of heavy metals, oxidative stress, expression of VHL, and antioxidant genes in the pathogenesis of renal cell carcinoma.
studies.Population: Renal cell carcinoma patients at a tertiary care centre and age-matched healthy volunteers
studies.comparison_type: Blood copper levels in RCC cases versus age-matched healthy controls

extraction_supporting_text.sample_size: 150 cases and 150 age matched controls were enrolled.
extraction_supporting_text.cases: 150 cases and 150 age matched controls were enrolled.
extraction_supporting_text.p_value: RCC cases had elevated blood levels of arsenic (P = 0.02), copper (P = 0.01)
extraction_supporting_text.comparison: RCC cases had elevated blood levels of arsenic (P = 0.02), copper (P = 0.01), manganese (P < 0.001), cadmium (P < 0.001), lead (P < 0.001), and mercury (P = 0.02) compared to controls.
extraction_supporting_text.design: This observational study recruited RCC patients who visited our tertiary care centre from 2019 to 2023. Age matched healthy volunteers were included as controls.
extraction_supporting_text.timing: recruited RCC patients who visited our tertiary care centre from 2019 to 2023
extraction_supporting_text.exposure_measurement: Levels of arsenic, copper, manganese, selenium, cadmium, lead, and mercury were measured in each of the samples.
